item.title: Disney CEO Bob Iger’s FY25 Pay Swells to $48.8 Million as Succession Talk Drags On and Power Games Take Center Stage
item.description: The Walt Disney Company has once again reminded everyone where its priorities sit, at least at the top of the corporate ladder. CEO Bob Iger saw his fiscal 2025 compensation climb to $48.8 million, a roughly 12% increase from the $41.1 million he pulled in the year before, according to the company’s annual proxy statement filed with the SEC.
